ctx.x: No, Sy came along much later than that. You see, Tommy always admired the Lunceford band.

The one thing that Tommy loved in a man's playing -- just playing jazz was not important enough -- that jazz had to have showmanship in it. Therefore -- well, a perfect reason for saying that is that he absolutely idolized Charles Shavers, and Charlie Shavers was a brilliant player but he was a theatrical player -- everything was done for an effect although he was a highly talented guy and I loved him, you know, but Tommy thought that Charlie Shavers was the greatest thing that ever happened, because Charlie…
